newsitem.title: INDIA: Price Waterhouse ready to invest $75 mln in India.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse ready to invest $75 mln in India.

text.p: U.S. consulting and audit company Price Waterhouse said on Friday that it is prepared to invest $75 million in the development of its business in India over the next five years.

"We are very excited by the pace of economic development here and believe that India is an important emerging market that will be an engine to power the future growth of the consulting and accounting business of our firm," chairman James Schiro said in a statement released in the Indian capital.

It said the bulk of Price Waterhouse's investment would be in the transfer of technology and management skills, training, development of local infrastructure and strategic alliances that "will significantly enhance the value of the service offering of the firm".

The statement said the announcement followed meetings on Friday morning between the Price Waterhouse India Leadership Group, headed by senior partner Amal Ganguli, and Schiro's team from the United States.

"We see India becoming an increasingly important investment destination in the key sectors in which our clients operate -- banking, insurance, energy, infrastructure and telecommunications," Schiro said.
